observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 40 stand in the left margin and the locators «p. 128.» (L1) and «p. 129.» (L28, beside the head of chapter 41) in the right margin. body L28-L32: the head of the chapter is set in a larger type; «CAPUT XLI.» is centred, the title is set as a paragraph of four lines, the second to the fourth indented.
body L1: the last two figures of «p. 128.» are printed blotted together.
body L28: in the locator «p. 129.» the 2 did not print; a low point stands in its place.
body L6: the t of «est» is printed broken, only the top of its stem.
body L27, L35: the letters of the references (b) and (a) are bold italic; with chapter 41 the letters begin again at a.
body L36: in «perigeum» the second e is printed broken, like a c, and a speck stands over the u.
notes_left L3: the foot of the 2 of «(2)» is printed broken.
